scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A uniform influence bound for hypergraph properties” (preprints/A-uniform-influence-bound-for-hypergraph-properties-October-5-2026/hypergraph-influences.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 186 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 64d690bef14f4214), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer r ≥ 3 there is a finite constant Cr such that, for every integer n ≥ r, every 0 < p < 1, and every hypergraph property f : {0, 1}En,r → {0, 1}, Varp(f) ≤ Cr (log n)r/(r−1) Ip(f). (1.1) No monotonicity assumption is required.
